verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents creating videos from a text prompt with control over avatar, voice, style and inputs, plus multi-shot cinematic prompts. It also supports iteration without restarting: you can review storyboards and send follow-up messages to the Video Agent before generating, and revise only named scenes while untouched scenes keep their script and visuals. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the prompt-to-video and scene-revision workflow (the community evidence covers only dubbing).
